behavior_constraints: Ensemble (and all) stage cache key computation sorts input port names alphabetically before concatenating upstream cache keys, producing deterministic keys regardless of Go map iteration order
For input ports like {"model_1":"a.model","model_0":"b.model","data":"split.test"}, the cache key input string orders ports as data, model_0, model_1
In continue-on-failure mode, when a stage's dependency was skipped (not failed), the dependent stage is marked "skipped" rather than "failed"
Skipping a stage does not invalidate existing cache entries from prior full runs
CV run history records include a stage_summary.folds key mapping fold index (as string) to a map of stage-name to {status, cache_hit?} for per-fold stages
The diff command accepts --param key=value flags and applies parameter substitution to BOTH configs before comparing them
Parameters supplied to diff that are unused in one or both configs are silently ignored
The validate command rejects ensemble stages with fewer than 2 model_* input ports, emitting error: "stage '<name>' ensemble requires at least 2 model inputs"
All other pipeline behavior, command interfaces, stage types, algorithms, caching mechanics, registry operations, and output formats remain unchanged
affected_prior: Run continue-on-failure cascade logic (round 4 stage skipping)
entities.summary: This round fixes ensemble/all-stage cache key determinism via alphabetically sorted input ports, corrects skipped-vs-failed cascade status in continue mode, adds per-fold stage_summary to CV run history, applies parameter substitution in the diff command, and adds ensemble min-2-model validation to the validate command.

instruction_head:
We've identified several correctness issues with the recently added features that need to be fixed.

## 1. Ensemble Stage Cache Key Correctness

The ensemble stage cache key computation has a bug. When an ensemble takes models from multiple stages, the cache key must include ALL upstream model cache keys in a deterministic order. Currently, the order depends on Go map iteration order (which is random), causing non-deterministic cache keys.
